content.direction: Other, no face: a big generic browser DevTools Network panel (no brand), four bookstore requests, the Status column coloured by class (200 and 201 mint, 404 amber, 502 tomato) and circled in marker. Everyone has seen this column; the words promise to explain it. References: viral real-screen thumbnails, her database-indexes thumbnail (one object, one marker).
